about_the_game:
This game is a trial version of game store simulator. Currently, you can play the game's opening plot, purchase goods, list goods, checkout, borrow from financial institutions, and manage interactive store facilities in the current trial version.

At present,the trial version has limited content and many details question.Please feel free to suggest or add us to the contact group on the right for further communication.

★ Procurement and Transportation

Purchase goods from different platform versions according to preferences and wait for express delivery. Currently, only the gaming category of goods is available, and logistics and supplier systems are under construction.

★ Customers are the most important

Customers may enter the store for shopping or gaming, or they may just come in out of curiosity to ensure that they do not wait too long at checkout.

★ Money never sleeps

If you feel that making money is too slow, you can try financial games with higher risks and greater returns, such as low interest loans and high interest storage, and more financial services are being built.
